resources.title: I Built The PERFECT Tavern For Each Valheim Biome
resources.creator: SmittySurvival
resources.noteEs: SmittySurvival diseña una taberna específica para cada bioma con materiales locales y estética acorde — wooden Meadows, dark Black Forest, stone Mountain. Cinematic editing y un showcase aprovechable como template.
resources.noteEn: SmittySurvival designs a tavern specific to each biome with local materials and matching aesthetics — wooden Meadows, dark Black Forest, stone Mountain. Cinematic editing and a showcase usable as a template.

resources.title: I Spent 40 Hours Building a CLASSIC Viking Village!
resources.creator: SmittySurvival
resources.noteEs: Proyecto de 40 horas: aldea vikinga completa con longhouse, harbor, granja y palisade. Time-lapse del proceso con explicación de design decisions — útil para entender cómo planificar un megabase desde cero.
resources.noteEn: A 40-hour project: a complete Viking village with longhouse, harbor, farm, and palisade. Time-lapse of the process with design-decision commentary — useful for understanding how to plan a megabase from scratch.

resources.title: 3 EASY Methods to Make BEAUTIFUL Walls in Valheim
resources.creator: SmittySurvival
resources.noteEs: Tutorial corto y enfocado: 3 técnicas de paredes (timber accent, stone facing, mixed materials) que cambian instantly el look de cualquier estructura. Para builders que quieren elevar su estética sin proyecto megabase.
resources.noteEn: Short, focused tutorial: 3 wall techniques (timber accent, stone facing, mixed materials) that instantly elevate any structure's look. For builders who want to lift their aesthetic without a megabase project.

resources.title: Valheim Builder VS Hardcore Survival | Living in a Castle
resources.creator: Versaugh
resources.noteEs: Episodio de la serie 'Builder VS Hardcore Survival' donde Versaugh termina y habita un castillo construido enteramente en una run permadeath. Combina build showcase con survival tension — referencia para quien quiere ambos lados del juego.
resources.noteEn: Episode of the 'Builder VS Hardcore Survival' series where Versaugh finishes and inhabits a castle built entirely on a permadeath run. Combines build showcase with survival tension — a reference for those wanting both sides of the game.

resources.title: 50+ BUILDING Tips in Valheim 2026 (Valheim Tips & Tricks)

resources.noteEn: Classic tip dump: 50+ short building tricks (snapping, hidden uses for pieces, structure optimization). Each tip explained in ~10 seconds. The community-link reference whenever someone asks how to achieve X effect.
